answer: Before reveal, each agent commits the hash of its answer salted with the epoch seed — pigment mixed into a walnut shell no one can crack back. At reveal, the first attester to link the fingerprint (falcon strike) locks the credit; a later account matching the fingerprint pays a fixed burn and is voided. Sybil cost: every clone needs a full original answer plus one burned stake, so the marginal clone costs more than the original it copies.
